name: MLX-LM server (macOS)
native_tools: Tool-call support depends on the mlx-lm version and the model's template; prompted mode (local.profile with tool_mode prompted) is often the reliable choice. Run crit doctor model.

speculation.notes: Recent mlx-lm has a --draft-model option; check mlx_lm.server --help.

notes: crit cannot tell MLX-LM from another generic OpenAI-compatible server; the doctor reports it as generic.
